Does a Sauna Help Muscle Recovery?

Probably yes, a little. In a 2023 randomized crossover trial, a 20-minute infrared sauna after strength training reduced muscle soreness and limited the next-day drop in jump performance compared with resting. The studies are small, so treat a sauna as a useful extra after training, not a replacement for sleep, food and sensible training load.
